metadata.title: Office of New Drugs Custom Medical Queries (OCMQs) (FDA web page)
metadata.edition: Content current as of 09/02/2026 · OCMQ Version 4.1 (terms released in MedDRA v27.0 or earlier)
metadata.legal_basis: FDA internal review practice (CDER Office of New Drugs), described in MAPP 6025.8. Informative; not binding on applicants. The OCMQ term lists are MedDRA-based and are not reproduced in PV Info.
metadata.applicability: OND review of adverse event data in NDAs, BLAs and supplements. Applicant use of OCMQs for safety evaluation is voluntary (MAPP 6025.8).

metadata_verification: Source-register metadata; dates and legal status require human verification.
limitations: English rule-based extraction; no GPT or paid API.
Candidates are not approved requirements. Read the original, qualifications and exceptions.
Scans, tables, other languages and implicit obligations may be missed. Zero candidates does not establish zero requirements.
